# Northwind Cloud Handbook

Northwind runs all production workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service in the Central India region. The platform team is on call from 09:00 to 21:00 IST; outside those hours, incidents page the secondary on-call engineer.

Deployments: every merge to main triggers GitHub Actions, which runs the test suite, builds a container image and pushes it to Azure Container Registry. Argo CD then syncs the new image tag to the cluster. A deployment is rolled back automatically if the error rate exceeds 2 percent within 10 minutes.

Secrets are stored in Azure Key Vault and mounted with the CSI secrets driver. Developers must never put secrets in Git.

Backups: the PostgreSQL database is backed up every 6 hours and backups are retained for 35 days.

Cost policy: development clusters are scaled to zero nodes at 22:00 IST every night to save money.
